# 1. Requirements
```{r requirements}
required_packages <- c(
  "readr", "dplyr", "ggplot2",
  "cluster", "factoextra", "clustrd"
)

installed <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(clustrd)

```

# 2. Load embeddings files

```{r load}
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

k_range <- 2:10
q_range <- 2:6

all_results <- list()

# Add caching
dir.create("output/rkm_cache", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/rkm_plots", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/rkm_results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```


# 3. Load saved RKM results
```{r run-rkm}
load_rkm_cached_results <- function(embedding_path) {
  embeddings <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  user_ids <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- embeddings[, -1]
  embedding_matrix <- scale(as.matrix(embedding_matrix))

  embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))

  full_file <- file.path(
    "output/rkm_cache",
    paste0("rkm_full_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds")
  )

  if (file.exists(full_file)) {
    return(readRDS(full_file))
  }

  dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)

  results_grid <- expand.grid(k = k_range, q = q_range)
  results_grid$Silhouette <- NA_real_
  results_grid$CH <- NA_real_
  
  results_grid$runtime_sec <- NA_real_
  results_grid$status <- "ok"
  results_grid$notes <- NA_character_

  rkm_models <- vector("list", nrow(results_grid))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(results_grid))) {
    k_val <- results_grid$k[i]
    q_val <- results_grid$q[i]

    cache_file <- file.path(
      "output/rkm_cache",
      paste0("rkm_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds")
    )

    if (!file.exists(cache_file)) next

    cached <- readRDS(cache_file)

    results_grid$Silhouette[i] <- cached$Silhouette
    results_grid$CH[i] <- cached$CH
    rkm_models[[i]] <- cached$model
  }

  valid_rows <- which(!is.na(results_grid$Silhouette))
  if (length(valid_rows) == 0) return(NULL)

  best_index <- which.max(results_grid$Silhouette)
  best_params <- results_grid[best_index, ]

  best_k <- best_params$k
  best_q <- best_params$q
  best_silhouette <- best_params$Silhouette
  best_rkm <- rkm_models[[best_index]]

  cluster_df <- data.frame(
    UserID = user_ids,
    Cluster = best_rkm$cluster
  )

  best_sil <- silhouette(best_rkm$cluster, dmat)

  pca <- prcomp(embedding_matrix)
  var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]

  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
    Cluster = as.factor(best_rkm$cluster)
  )

  list(
    embedding_path = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
    embedding_matrix = embedding_matrix,
    user_ids = user_ids,
    results_grid = results_grid,
    best_index = best_index,
    best_params = best_params,
    best_k = best_k,
    best_q = best_q,
    best_silhouette = best_silhouette,
    best_rkm = best_rkm,
    best_sil = best_sil,
    cluster_df = cluster_df,
    dmat = dmat,
    pca_df = pca_df,
    var_explained = var_explained
  )
}

```

# 4. Fit embeddings with caching
```{r}

all_results <- list()

for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {

  if (!file.exists(embedding_path)) {
    cat("Missing file:", embedding_path, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_path, "\n")
  
  embedding_t0 <- Sys.time()
  
  embeddings <- read_csv(embedding_path)
  
  user_ids <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- embeddings[, -1]
  # embedding_matrix <- as.matrix(embedding_matrix)
  embedding_matrix <- scale(embedding_matrix)
  
  embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))
  
  full_file <- file.path(
    "output/rkm_cache",
    paste0("rkm_full_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds")
  )

  if (file.exists(full_file)) {
    cat("Loading FULL cached result for:", embedding_tag, "\n")
    all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- readRDS(full_file)
    next
  }
  
  dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)
  
  results_grid <- expand.grid(k = k_range, q = q_range)
  results_grid$Silhouette <- NA_real_
  results_grid$CH <- NA_real_
  
  results_grid$runtime_sec <- NA_real_
  results_grid$status <- rep("ok", nrow(results_grid))
  results_grid$notes <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(results_grid))

  
  rkm_models <- vector("list", nrow(results_grid))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(results_grid))) {
    k_val <- results_grid$k[i]
    q_val <- results_grid$q[i]
    
    cache_file <- file.path(
      "output/rkm_cache",
      paste0("rkm_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds")
    )
    
    if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
      cat("Loading cached result for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "q =", q_val, "\n")
      cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
      
      model <- cached$model
      avg_sil <- cached$Silhouette
      ch_val <- cached$CH
      
    } else {
      cat("Running RKM for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "q =", q_val, "\n")
      
      t0 <- Sys.time()

      model <- tryCatch(
        cluspca(
          embedding_matrix,
          nclus = k_val,
          ndim = q_val,
          method = "RKM",
          rotation = "varimax"
        ),
        warning = function(w) {
          results_grid$status[i] <- "warning"
          results_grid$notes[i] <- conditionMessage(w)
          invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
        },
        error = function(e) {
          results_grid$status[i] <- "error"
          results_grid$notes[i] <- conditionMessage(e)
          NULL
        }
      )
      
      results_grid$runtime_sec[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
      
      if (is.null(model)) next

      sil <- silhouette(model$cluster, dmat)
      avg_sil <- mean(sil[, 3])
      
      ch_val <- intCriteria(
        traj = embedding_matrix,
        part = as.integer(model$cluster),
        crit = "Calinski_Harabasz"
      )$calinski_harabasz
      
      saveRDS(
        list(
          model = model,
          Silhouette = avg_sil,
          CH = ch_val,
          runtime_sec = results_grid$runtime_sec[i],
          status = results_grid$status[i],
          notes = results_grid$notes[i],
          k = k_val,
          q = q_val,
          embedding_path = embedding_path
        ),
        cache_file
      )
    }
    
    results_grid$Silhouette[i] <- avg_sil
    results_grid$CH[i] <- ch_val
    rkm_models[[i]] <- model
  }
  
  best_index <- which.max(results_grid$Silhouette)
  best_params <- results_grid[best_index, ]

  best_k <- best_params$k
  best_q <- best_params$q
  best_silhouette <- best_params$Silhouette
  best_rkm <- rkm_models[[best_index]]

  cluster_df <- data.frame(
    UserID = user_ids,
    Cluster = best_rkm$cluster
  )
  
  best_sil <- silhouette(best_rkm$cluster, dmat)

  pca <- prcomp(embedding_matrix)
  var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]

  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
    Cluster = as.factor(best_rkm$cluster)
  )

  runtime_total_sec <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), embedding_t0, units = "secs"))
  
  cluster_sizes <- table(cluster_df$Cluster)

  notes_text <- NA_character_
  if ("notes" %in% names(results_grid)) {
    tmp_notes <- unique(na.omit(results_grid$notes))
    if (length(tmp_notes) > 0) {
      notes_text <- paste(tmp_notes, collapse = " | ")
    }
  }
  
  summary_row <- data.frame(
    method = "RKM",
    embedding = embedding_tag,
    best_k = best_k,
    best_q = best_q,
    silhouette = best_params$Silhouette,
    CH = best_params$CH,
    prob_silh = NA,
    cluster_size_min = min(cluster_sizes),
    cluster_size_max = max(cluster_sizes),
    cluster_size_sd = sd(as.numeric(cluster_sizes)),
    runtime_total_sec = runtime_total_sec,
    notes = notes_text
  )
  all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- list(
    embedding_path = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
    embedding_matrix = embedding_matrix,
    user_ids = user_ids,
    results_grid = results_grid,
    best_index = best_index,
    best_params = best_params,
    best_k = best_k,
    best_q = best_q,
    best_silhouette = best_silhouette,
    best_rkm = best_rkm,
    best_sil = best_sil,
    cluster_df = cluster_df,
    dmat = dmat,
    pca_df = pca_df,
    var_explained = var_explained,
    runtime_total_sec = runtime_total_sec,
    summary_row = summary_row,
    stability_info = list(
      seeds_tested = NA,
      n_runs = NA,
      chosen_k_values = NA,
      chosen_q_values = NA,
      ari_mean = NA,
      ari_sd = NA,
      stability_notes = NA_character_
    )
  )
  
  cat("Saved results for:", embedding_tag, "\n")

}
```

# 5. Show results for all embeddings
```{r results-rkm}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  cat("\n==========", name, "==========\n")
  cat("Best k:", res$best_k, "\n")
  cat("Best q:", res$best_q, "\n")
  cat("Best silhouette:", res$best_params$Silhouette, "\n")
  cat("Best CH:", res$best_params$CH, "\n")
  cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
  print(table(res$cluster_df$Cluster))
}
```

# 6. Plot tuning results for all embeddings
```{r plot-tuning}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  p1 <- ggplot(res$results_grid, aes(x = q, y = Silhouette, color = factor(k), group = k)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Silhouette by q and k -", name),
      x = "Reduced Dimension (q)",
      y = "Average Silhouette Width",
      color = "Clusters (k)"
    )

  print(p1)

  ggsave(
    file.path("output/rkm_plots", paste0("silhouette_", name, ".png")),
    p1, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120
  )

  p2 <- ggplot(res$results_grid, aes(x = q, y = CH, color = factor(k), group = k)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("CH by q and k -", name),
      x = "Reduced Dimension (q)",
      y = "Calinski-Harabasz Index",
      color = "Clusters (k)"
    )

  print(p2)

  ggsave(
    file.path("output/rkm_plots", paste0("ch_", name, ".png")),
    p2, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120
  )
}
```

# 7. Plot silhouette for best models
```{r plot-sil}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  png(
    filename = file.path(
      "output/rkm_plots",
      paste0("silhouette_plot_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".png")
    ),
    width = 1200,
    height = 800,
    res = 120
  )

  plot(
    res$best_sil,
    main = paste("Reduced K-Means Silhouette Plot -", name,
                 "(k =", res$best_k, ", q =", res$best_q, ")"),
    col = "blue",
    border = NA
  )

  dev.off()

  plot(
    res$best_sil,
    main = paste("Reduced K-Means Silhouette Plot -", name,
                 "(k =", res$best_k, ", q =", res$best_q, ")"),
    col = "blue",
    border = NA
  )
}

```

# 8. Plot PCA for all embeddings
```{r pca}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  p_pca <- ggplot(res$pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Reduced K-Means Clusters (PCA Projection) -", name,
                    "k =", res$best_k, ", q =", res$best_q),
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * res$var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * res$var_explained[2], 1), "%)")
    )

  print(p_pca)

  ggsave(
    file.path("output/rkm_plots", paste0("pca_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".png")),
    p_pca, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 120
  )
}
```

# 9. Choose best overall embedding
```{r best-rkm}
all_best <- lapply(all_results, function(res) {
  data.frame(
    embedding = res$embedding_tag,
    best_k = res$best_k,
    best_q = res$best_q,
    Silhouette = res$best_params$Silhouette,
    CH = res$best_params$CH
  )
})

all_best_df <- bind_rows(all_best)
print(all_best_df)

best_overall_index <- with(all_best_df, order(-Silhouette, -CH))[1]
best_overall <- all_best_df[best_overall_index, ]
print(best_overall)

best_name <- best_overall$embedding
best_res <- all_results[[best_name]]

best_rkm <- best_res$best_rkm
best_cluster_df <- best_res$cluster_df
best_pca_df <- best_res$pca_df
best_k <- best_res$best_k
best_q <- best_res$best_q

```

# 10. Save per-embedding results
```{r save}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]

  write.csv(
    res$cluster_df,
    file = file.path("output/rkm_results", paste0("rkm_clusters_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    res$results_grid,
    file = file.path("output/rkm_results", paste0("rkm_tuning_results_", name, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(
    res$best_rkm,
    file = file.path("output/rkm_cache", paste0("best_rkm_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".rds"))
  )

  saveRDS(
    res,
    file = file.path("output/rkm_cache", paste0("rkm_full_result_", name, ".rds"))
  )
}

write.csv(
  best_cluster_df,
  file = file.path("output/rkm_results", paste0("rkm_best_overall_clusters_", best_name, "_k", best_k, "_q", best_q, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  all_best_df,
  file = file.path("output/rkm_results", "rkm_best_overall_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

all_summary_df <- bind_rows(lapply(all_results, function(x) x$summary_row))

write.csv(
  all_summary_df,
  file = file.path("output/rkm_results", "rkm_summary_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
